metadata.author: ChipLoom / Codex
metadata.description: V2 of the original 80-bar chip arrangement: a deeper pre-drop vacuum, stronger drum and bass entrance, and an expressive sixteen-bar solo.
metadata.display_description: Voltage Odyssey V2 : coupure plus profonde, basse et batterie renforcées aux drops ; solo réécrit avec notes chantantes, glissés et vibrato retardé.
revision_details: Six-row pre-drop silence and reduced harmony before it
Kick/snare composite and square bass in four ProTracker channels
Rephrased solo with delayed vibrato, tone portamento, grace notes and quieter answers
metadata.arrangement: 80 bars at 164 BPM. Intro 8 / theme 8 / lift 4 / build 4 / drop 16 / break 8 / solo 16 / rebuild 4 / final drop 8 / outro 4. The MOD returns to the theme after its written ending.
metadata.sample_provenance: All PCM synthesized here or from project recipes; no reference samples loaded.
metadata.reference_use: Structural lessons: stable accompaniment, targeted variants, short waveform changes and tracker articulation. New melody and arrangement.
metadata.note_convention: ProTracker C-1..B-3, not scientific octave numbers
